event_feifei_rescue_return_fish_r1.scene: SETTING as in reference image 4: a staircase of big warm-orange-lit stone blocks going down to the right, with a tall dark stone-block wall at the top left. The same VILLAGE CAT as in reference image 3 (golden-orange ginger tabby with darker orange stripes, white muzzle, white chest and white paws, pink ears, big brown eyes, no clothes, no bandage) sits at the top of the stairs beside the wall, quietly watching Feifei leave with sad eyes. Feifei walks down the steps away from it, head bowed, eyes downcast and dazed, not looking back; small wobble lines around the steps and a dizzy squiggle beside her head, as if the stairs are swaying under her feet.
